_harness_comment: Claude Code intact. 'tools': null leaves the CLI's own default set in place.
_semi_comment: Claude Code with a narrowed tool set: the agent keeps its own loop but only over the tools listed here. The default is read-only, which is why this mode is safe to expose when harness is not. A request may narrow the set further via X-Claude-Tools, but never widen it past this list; set allowRequestTools false to ignore the header entirely.
_usage_comment: Token history, one row per turn plus one per model call and tool call inside it. Persisted with node:sqlite so it survives a restart; set persist false to keep it in a memory ring buffer instead. retentionDays 0 keeps everything.
_dashboard_comment: localAutoAuth lets a dashboard opened on this machine fetch the API tokens and connect without you pasting one. Only ever disclosed to a direct loopback request. Set false to always require manual entry.
_models_comment: Optional. Omit to use the default catalog. Rename 'id' freely: it is what clients see, while 'model' is what the CLI is told. A 'semi' or 'harness' entry may carry its own 'tools' list, overriding the mode's default, so one catalog can offer several differently-privileged agents.
